<DESCRIPTION>EQUITY EXCHANGE AGREEMENT
<TEXT>

<HEAD>
     <TITLE></TITLE>
</HEAD>
<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><B>Exhibit 10.1</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B><U>EQUITY EXCHANGE AGREEMENT</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>This Equity Exchange Agreement</B> (the &ldquo;Agreement&rdquo;) is
made and entered into as of this 16th day of October, 2024 (the &ldquo;Effective Date&rdquo;), by and among <B>Allied Energy, Inc.</B>,
a Florida corporation (&ldquo;AGGI&rdquo;), <B>Metamexx Corp</B>, a Canadian corporation and wholly-owned subsidiary of AGGI (&ldquo;Metamexx&rdquo;),
<B>Bili Inc.</B>, a Canadian corporation (&ldquo;Bili&rdquo;), and the shareholders of Bili listed on <B>Exhibit A</B> attached hereto (collectively,
the &ldquo;Bili Shareholders&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>WHEREAS</B>, AGGI is a corporation organized under the laws of the
State of Florida, with its principal office located at Rooms 3229-3231, 32/F Sun Hung Kai Centre, 30 Harbour Road, Wanchai, Hong Kong;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>WHEREAS</B>, Metamexx is a corporation organized under the laws
of Canada, with its principal office located in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, and is a wholly-owned subsidiary of AGGI;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>WHEREAS</B>, Bili is a corporation organized under the laws of Canada,
with its principal office located in Toronto, Ontario, Canada;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>WHEREAS</B>, the Bili Shareholders own shares of common stock in
Bili (the &ldquo;Bili Shares&rdquo;);</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>WHEREAS</B>, AGGI desires to acquire, through its subsidiary Metamexx,
up to 100% of the issued and outstanding Bili Shares in exchange for shares of AGGI&rsquo;s Preferred B Stock (the &ldquo;AGGI Preferred B Shares&rdquo;),
and the Bili Shareholders desire to exchange their Bili Shares for AGGI Preferred B Shares on the terms and conditions set forth herein;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>WHEREAS</B>, the parties entered into a Memorandum of Understanding
dated July 24, 2024 (the &ldquo;MOU&rdquo;), and now wish to supersede the MOU with this Agreement;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>NOW, THEREFORE</B>, in consideration of the mutual covenants and
agreements herein contained, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged,
the parties agree as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<HR ALIGN="CENTER" STYLE="width: 96%">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>1. Definitions</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">1.1 <B>&ldquo;AGGI Preferred B Shares&rdquo;</B> means the shares of
Preferred B Stock of AGGI to be issued to the Bili Shareholders pursuant to this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">1.2 <B>&ldquo;Bili Shares&rdquo;</B> means the issued and outstanding
shares of common stock of Bili held by the Bili Shareholders.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">1.3 <B>&ldquo;Closing&rdquo;</B> means the consummation of the transactions
contemplated by this Agreement, to occur on the Effective Date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">1.4 <B>&ldquo;Effective Date&rdquo;</B> means the date first written
above.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<HR ALIGN="CENTER" STYLE="width: 96%">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>2. Exchange of Shares</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">2.1 <B>Exchange Ratio and Issuance</B>. Subject to the terms and conditions
of this Agreement, at the Closing:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" BORDER="0" STYLE="width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8226;</FONT></TD>
  <TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(a)</FONT></TD>
  <TD><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The Bili Shareholders shall sell, assign, transfer, convey,
  and deliver to Metamexx an aggregate of 5,430,681 Bili Shares, representing between 95% to 100% of the issued and outstanding shares
  of Bili.</FONT></TD></TR>
</TABLE>


<P STYLE="text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></P>

  <TD><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In consideration thereof, AGGI shall issue and deliver
  to the Bili Shareholders, or their designated nominees, an aggregate of 117,318,448 AGGI Preferred B Shares, as detailed in <B>Exhibit
  A</B> attached hereto.</FONT></TD></TR>
</TABLE>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">2.2 <B>Fractional Shares</B>. No fractional AGGI Preferred B Shares
shall be issued. Any fractional shares shall be rounded to the nearest whole number.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">2.3 <B>Further Assurances</B>. The directors of Bili shall use their
best efforts to procure the remaining Bili shareholders to exchange their Bili Shares for AGGI Preferred B Shares as soon as practicable
after the Closing, with the intention that Bili will become a 100% subsidiary of Metamexx, alternatively, the remaining Bili shareholders
may cancel their remaining shares in Bili.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<HR ALIGN="CENTER" STYLE="width: 96%">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>3. Consideration</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">3.1 <B>No Cash Consideration</B>. The exchange of shares pursuant to
this Agreement is a stock-for-stock transaction. No cash or other form of consideration shall be paid.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<HR ALIGN="CENTER" STYLE="width: 96%">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>4. Closing</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">4.1 <B>Closing Date</B>. The Closing shall take place on the Effective
Date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">4.2 <B>Deliveries at Closing</B>:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>5. Representations and Warranties</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">5.1 <B>Representations and Warranties of Bili and the Bili Shareholders</B>.
Bili and each Bili Shareholder, jointly and severally, represent and warrant to AGGI and Metamexx that:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P><B>7. Confidentiality</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">7.1 <B>Confidentiality Obligations</B>. The parties agree to maintain
the confidentiality of the terms of this Agreement and any non-public information disclosed in connection with the transactions contemplated
herein, except as required by law or regulation.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<HR ALIGN="CENTER" STYLE="width: 96%">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>8. Governing Law and Jurisdiction</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">8.1 <B>Governing Law</B>. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed
in accordance with the laws of Hong Kong.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">8.2 <B>Jurisdiction</B>. The parties irrevocably submit to the exclusive
jurisdiction of the courts of Hong Kong for any suit, action, or proceeding arising out of this Agreement or any transaction contemplated
hereby.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>9. Dispute Resolution</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">9.1 <B>Arbitration</B>. Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising
out of or relating to this Agreement, including its validity, invalidity, breach, or termination, shall be resolved by arbitration administered
by the Hong Kong International Arbitration Centre (HKIAC) in accordance with the HKIAC Administered Arbitration Rules in force at the
time of the arbitration.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">9.2 <B>Arbitration Proceedings</B>. The seat of arbitration shall be
Hong Kong. The language of the arbitration shall be English. The number of arbitrators shall be one.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<HR ALIGN="CENTER" STYLE="width: 96%">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>10. Miscellaneous</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">10.1 <B>Entire Agreement</B>. This Agreement, including all exhibits
and schedules hereto, supersedes all prior agreements and understandings, including the MOU dated July 24, 2024, between the parties regarding
its subject matter.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">10.2 <B>Amendments</B>. This Agreement may not be amended or modified
except by a written agreement signed by all parties.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">10.3 <B>Assignment</B>. No party may assign its rights or obligations
under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other parties.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">10.4 <B>Counterparts</B>. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts,
each of which shall be deemed an original, but all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">10.5 <B>No Third-Party Beneficiaries</B>. This Agreement is for the
sole benefit of the parties hereto and their respective successors and permitted assigns.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">10.6 <B>Notices</B>. Any notice required or permitted under this Agreement
shall be in writing and deemed duly given when delivered in person or sent by registered or certified mail, postage prepaid, or by recognized
courier service, to the addresses of the parties as set forth below or to such other address as any party may designate by notice to the
others.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<HR ALIGN="CENTER" STYLE="width: 96%">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">11.1 <B>Tax Matters</B>. No representations or warranties are made
regarding the tax consequences of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement. Each party shall be responsible for its own tax obligations
arising from this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">12.1 <B>Actions to Effect Transaction</B>. Each party agrees to execute
and deliver such documents and take such actions as may be reasonably necessary to carry out the provisions of this Agreement and to consummate
the transactions contemplated hereby.</P>
